prompt_text: What is the best home care agency in Pleasanton CA for an elderly parent?
answer_verbatim:
There isn’t enough reliable, comparable review information to name one agency as definitively “best.” For a Pleasanton family, I’d start by interviewing **Senior Helpers of Pleasanton** and **Hired Hands Homecare**, then compare them with one other local agency that fits your parent’s needs.

- **Senior Helpers of Pleasanton** has a local office and lists California Home Care Organization license **#414700072**. [Website](https://www.seniorhelpers.com/ca/pleasanton/)
- **Hired Hands Homecare** serves Pleasanton and advertises dementia care, care management, and support ranging from companionship to around-the-clock help. [BBB profile](https://www.bbb.org/us/ca/pleasanton/profile/home-care/hired-hands-homecare-1116-129879/addressId/33106)
- **Comfort Keepers of Pleasanton** is another option to compare; one directory listing reports 4.8 stars from 19 reviews, though directory ratings alone aren’t enough to judge care quality. [Local agency listings](https://www.agingcare.com/local/in-home-care/pleasanton-ca)

Before choosing, ask each agency to confirm its current California license, explain how it screens and supervises caregivers, describe backup coverage for missed shifts, and provide a written rate and care plan. Request a meeting with the proposed caregiver, and ask for references from families with similar needs. If your parent needs **skilled nursing or therapy** rather than help with daily activities, ask their clinician about a Medicare-certified home health agency; that’s a different service from nonmedical home care.
